name: BudgetBook
tagline: Personal finance — budgets, expense tracking, bank CSV/OFX import and charts.
description: Track income and expenses, set category budgets, and import transactions from bank CSV or OFX/QFX files with auto-categorization rules. Visualize spending trends, cash flow and net worth with charts, and see budget-vs-actual at a glance. All data is stored locally — a private money manager.
